# Chapter 05 · Conditional Expectation and Projection {.unnumbered}
*Hilbert Space · Orthogonal Projection · Best Prediction · CEF*

조건부기대값을 $L^2$ 공간의 orthogonal projection으로 해석하고, residual orthogonality·variance decomposition·information set·linear CEF를 population prediction 언어로 정리한다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **5.1–5.4** $L^2$ geometry, projection theorem, conditional expectation
- **5.5–5.8** residual orthogonality, prediction error, information, variance decomposition
- **5.9–5.10** CEF·linear CEF와 restricted predictor classes
- **5.11** 요약과 연습문제
:::
